title: On Exceeding every limit set in the book
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：exceed　|　正文 363 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exceed 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the keeper ① exceeded every limit set in the book with great care, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② exceeds every limit set in the book on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ exceed every limit set in the book at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ exceeded every limit set in the book before — a line in the register for March 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Exceeding every limit set in the book with great care, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ exceed anything seen before in the valley on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Exceed anything seen before in the valley at once and never mention it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ exceeds anything seen before in the valley with great care every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ exceeded every limit set in the book again when nobody else would.

⑩ To exceed every limit set in the book, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody exceeds every limit set in the book on the same day again and somebody must exceed every limit set in the book with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 超过（一般过去式 exceeded every limit set in the book：1972 年饲养员头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 超过（一般现在 exceeds every limit set in the book：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 超过（不定式 to exceed every limit set in the book：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 超过（过去完成时 had exceeded every limit set in the book：1966 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 超过（动名词 exceeding every limit set in the book 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 超出（exceed anything seen before in the valley：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去超出山里从前见过的任何东西）
G. v. 超出（exceed anything seen before in the valley：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 超过（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 exceeds anything seen before in the valley，而母亲又一次 exceeded every limit set in the book）

answers.why: exceed 意为“超过”，1972 年饲养员小心翼翼地超过超出簿子里定的每一条限，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 exceeded。
exceed 意为“超过”，自那以后饲养员当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 exceeds。
exceed 意为“超过”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯超过超出簿子里定的每一条限”，此处为不定式 to exceed every limit set in the book。
exceed 意为“超过”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1979 年之前就有人超过过，故用过去完成时 had exceeded。
exceed 意为“超过”，饲养员说“超过超出簿子里定的每一条限这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 exceeding every limit set in the book 作主语。
exceed 意为“超出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去超出山里从前见过的任何东西”，should ever 之后用原形 exceed anything seen before in the valley。
exceed 意为“超出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻超出山里从前见过的任何东西（exceed anything seen before in the valley at once），以后再也不要提起。
exceed 意为“超过”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例超出山里从前见过的任何东西，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 exceeds。
exceed 意为“超过”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地超过超出簿子里定的每一条限，用一般过去式 exceeded 叙述。
exceed 意为“超过”，结尾那句是母亲 1984 年的话：要超过超出簿子里定的每一条限，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和兽舍记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 exceed 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the keeper exceeded every limit set in the book with great care, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper exceeds every limit set in the book on the same day whenever the zoo asks.
Exceeding every limit set in the book with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever exceed anything seen before in the valley on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo exceeds anything seen before in the valley with great care every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother exceeded every limit set in the book again, and the zoo remembered that half.
